$comment: Pins the exact third-party module bits every team member must run. tasks.py verify-modules checks compose/ignition/modules/ against this. Fill in sha256 after the first download (tasks.py hash-modules prints them).
notes: All Cirrus Link module versions MUST match exactly. Cirrus documents class-loading instability when they do not.
The 5.x line is the one compatible with Ignition 8.3.x. Do not use 4.x.
These are licensed binaries and are gitignored. See compose/ignition/MODULES.md.

modules.name: MQTT Engine
modules.purpose: Northbound consumer. Sparkplug B ingest (pattern 2) and Custom Namespace ingest for plain-MQTT payloads (pattern 1).

modules.name: MQTT Transmission
modules.purpose: Sparkplug B edge node (pattern 2) and the publish path for patterns 3-7.

modules.name: MQTT Distributor
modules.purpose: In-gateway MQTT broker. NOT the primary broker - Chariot is. Present as break-glass fallback if Chariot's independent trial timer bites on stage. Disabled by default.
